initialize_model_parallel_seeds: initialize model parallel CUDA seeds for tensor and data parallel groups with a given seed
fork_cuda_rng_state: fork the CUDA RNG state to perform operations then restore the original state
split_tensor_into_chunks: split a tensor into equal 1D chunks across tensor model parallel ranks
gather_split_tensor: gather split 1D tensor values from all model parallel ranks into a single tensor
set_cuda_rng_state: set the CUDA random number generator state on the current GPU device
